attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Target Changed
attributes.description: Detects changes to a recovery or restore target that may alter where protected data is recovered.
author: Druva
false_positives: Approved change to a restore destination during maintenance or capacity management.
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
attributes.query:
druva.feature:"Admin Event"
and druva.event_type:"Recovery Target Changed"
attributes.note:
### Investigation guide

This rule detects an administrative change to a Druva recovery target. An unauthorized target change could alter where protected data is restored or interfere with established recovery procedures.

#### Investigation steps

- Identify the administrator and affected recovery configuration.
- Determine the previous and new recovery target when available.
- Confirm that the new destination is approved and expected.
- Review the source IP and other administrative actions by the same account.
- Search for nearby recovery operations, protection changes, repository changes, or suspicious security events.
- Determine whether sensitive data was subsequently restored to the changed target.

#### Response

- Revert unauthorized target changes.
- Review recovery activity performed after the modification.
- Investigate the responsible administrator account when the change cannot be validated.
